phase_name: Add the implement forwarding arm in skill-base.sh, with coverage

notes: Confirmed by reading: the elif arm sits inside the existing case "$status" in researched|planned|implemented) block, and "$operation" (literal "implement") is what skill_postflight_update forwards as target_status to update-task-status.sh -- confirmed via live call sites in orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh/orchestrate-stage5-postflight.sh. Isolated 2 pre-existing/environmental suite failures (test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, test-orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh) in the 21-suite tier run, same 2 already attributed to concurrent sibling tasks in phase 3; see issue log.
